source.title: [FLINK-39218] Introduce Flink-Kafka Transactions Management Tool
source.search_operation: Targeted current-source-family verification for FLINK-39218 in apache/flink-connector-kafka pull requests; then exact PR API read.

observation: The direct Apache Flink Kafka connector PR implementing the FLINK-39218 transaction-management proposal is closed with merged_at=null. Its own description calls the mechanism a standalone CLI tool that lets operators manually abort or commit lingering Kafka transactions after an exactly-once sink stops unexpectedly and is not restarted. The abort path fences the previous producer via initTransactions(); the commit path resumes the exact producerId/epoch from Flink checkpoint state.
failure_mechanism: Within this exact implementation family, the proposed repair does not become an integrated automatic post-crash broker reconciliation path: the candidate is explicitly operator-invoked and was not merged. Therefore this source family does not remove the residual external/manual recovery dependency identified in FE-500.
falsifying_trace: Unexpected Flink KafkaSink EXACTLY_ONCE stop leaves the lingering-transaction problem defined by FLINK-39218.
PR #238 proposes resolving it with a standalone KafkaTransactionTool CLI operated manually.
GitHub reports PR #238 closed on 2026-08-12 with merged_at=null and labels stale/closed-stale.
Thus this exact proposed implementation family supplies neither a merged integrated path nor an automatic scheduled-Chat-native broker postcondition repair.
exact_scope_guard: Limited to apache/flink-connector-kafka PR #238 / FLINK-39218's proposed transaction-management implementation and its observed GitHub state through 2026-09-01. This does not prove that no independent merged Flink implementation exists elsewhere, does not generalize to all Kafka/Flink recovery, and does not establish future behavior after a new implementation merges.

phase1_assessment.reason: The PR explicitly implements a standalone operator CLI; it is closed unmerged, so this source family does not eliminate manual/external execution.

exact_next_action: Fresh-bootstrap next invocation, then inspect exactly one non-duplicate current apache/flink-connector-kafka code/source family for an integrated automatic broker-side reconciliation hook for lingering EXACTLY_ONCE transactions after unexpected stop. A no-match must remain search-level only; do not infer repository-wide absence from one query. Preserve zero-manual, zero-finite-quota and zero-cost gates.
